messages:
anya: Quick question — attendance for the weekly engineering triage has been slipping. Can we nudge the schedule from Wed 09:00 to Tue 11:00 (PT)? Lower conflict with product sync and should give more overlap with APAC. Thoughts?

sam: Tue 11 mostly works for me but I have a standing call every other Tue at 11:15. Would prefer Tue 10:30 if folks can do it.

lina: I can do Tue 11 but +1 for 10:30 if that helps Sam. We should avoid pushing into lunch for EMEA.

miguel: +1 for swapping days. Also want to propose we tighten the agenda: 10m backlog triage, 10m bugs, 10m owner handoffs / follow-ups, 5m quick RFCs (if any). Keeps it to 35m strictly.

anya: Thanks — logical. Proposed agenda snippet:```
- 0:00 - quick status (2m)
- 0:02 - backlog highlight (10m)
- 0:12 - bug queue triage (10m)
- 0:22 - owner assignments & rollups (10m)
- 0:32 - RFC / ask slot (3m)
- 0:35 - wrap (2m)
```
Can we add a small rule: owners must post a 1-line update in this thread 24h before the call for any active items?

pete: I can take next week's owner rotation and do the 24h post. I'll ping owners tonight for their items.

sam: If we move to Tue 10:30 I'm in. If not, I'm fine with Tue 11 but will miss first 15m on alternating weeks.

lina: If alternating misses are predictable, maybe owners can swap weeks. We could do a 4-week rotation to spread load.

miguel: Suggestion: owners list = core infra, runtime, infra-ml, product-eng. Each owner has a 4-week cadence. Pete takes infra this cycle. I'll take runtime the following.

anya: OK. Action items: 1) vote on new time (quick react poll), 2) Pete posts owner commitments tonight, 3) I'll update the triage doc and calendar invite once time is confirmed.

ops-bot: Poll created — Tue 10:30 / Tue 11:00 / keep Wed 09:00 — vote here: <https://polls.example.com/1763001234>

sam: voted 10:30 :thumbsup:

lina: voted 10:30 :thumbsup:

pete: voted 10:30 :thumbsup: and I'll post the owners list by EOD.

miguel: voted 11:00 as backup (have oncall shift Tue am occasionally)

anya: Small tweak to agenda — add a pinned PRs section under backlog so reviewers know priority. Will pin guidelines in the doc.

pete: Posted owners and quick notes: infra=@pete, runtime=@miguel, infra-ml=@lina, product-eng=@sam. Each will add 1-line updates here 24h before the call.

anya: Thanks — looks good. If poll stays 10:30 by EOD I'll update calendar and set recurrence weekly Tue 10:30 PT with 35m duration.

devx-bot: Calendar update scheduled once organizer confirms. Reminder: use /triage-pulse to attach backlog snapshot before meeting.

lina: One more ask — can we reserve the last 3 minutes for quick RFCs only (no design deep dives)? If deeper, schedule a separate slot.

anya: Agreed. RFCs only, and deep dives get a follow-up. I'll add that to the doc.

sam: Sounds good. Thanks everyone for the quick replies.

pete: I'll also drop a pinned message in the triage channel with the new owner rotation table.

anya: Closing this thread for now — will post calendar update once poll results finalize. Appreciate the fast turnaround! (reaction :heart: )
